sceneConcept: A heavily built thirty-five-year-old Chinese enforcement specialist stands motionless against a transparent background. A short thick neck, broad shoulders, close black crew cut and dark brown inspection gaze create quiet pressure. He wears a plain matte black sleeveless compression shirt, charcoal cargo trousers, a compact utility belt and black combat boots. Only his right arm is covered from shoulder to wrist by dense horizontal bands of microscopic black Latin capital lettering, readable as text texture at portrait distance without fixing an invented sentence. Both arms hang naturally at his sides. Soft even frontal studio light keeps his breathing-still posture stark. Visual refresh: a sleeveless armored dock jacket, heavy cargo trousers and the full right-arm tattoo.
naturalLanguageDetail: A heavily built thirty-five-year-old Chinese enforcement specialist with a short thick neck and close black crew cut stands almost breathlessly still in a plain black sleeveless shirt, while only his right arm is covered shoulder to wrist by dense horizontal bands of microscopic black Latin capital lettering too small to resolve into a sentence under soft even frontal studio light; a sleeveless armored dock jacket, heavy cargo trousers and the full right-arm tattoo.
